generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Normalizes signals, binds provenance, clusters related findings, and maps convergence, divergence, dependencies, and opposing viewpoints.

contract.purpose_user_function: Normalize and deduplicate sources/evidence, bind provenance, group related material, and map supporting, contradictory, mixed, or missing evidence.
contract.valid_inputs: Source packs, evidence items, claims, exact quotes, candidate identifiers, provenance/hashes, and supporting/contradicting links.
contract.expected_outputs: Merged source/evidence packs, normalized IDs, evidence links, claim-evidence alignments, gaps, and controversy/literature maps.
contract.state_side_effects: Persists organized synthesis structures and removes duplicate source/evidence records by deterministic keys.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Fails or flags invalid evidence links, absent spans, unsupported claims, or inconsistent provenance.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Convergence/divergence and contradictions are represented; richer semantic clusters and dependency graphs are limited.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Test normalization, duplicate merge, provenance binding, cluster/group, support, contradiction, mixed evidence, dependency, opposing viewpoint, and invalid-link rejection.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md#Appendix: AutoSci Commands (`/discover`, `/research`, `/survey`); docs/integrations/autosci/full-parity-progress-report.md#Remaining Partial/Gated Routes documents incomplete global parity, provider-gated routes, and remaining semantic-proof gaps.
